realtime.unsupported_frontend.zh: 不支持的 Realtime 前台：{name}

realtime.unsupported_frontend_with_optio.zh: 不支持的 Realtime 前台：{name}（可选 {options}）

realtime.unsupported_model.zh: 不支持的 Realtime 模型：{id}

realtime.unsupported_model_with_provider.zh: 不支持的 Realtime 模型：{id}（{label}）

realtime.provider_needs_key_and_label.en: a Realtime Provider must define key and label
realtime.provider_needs_key_and_label.zh: Realtime Provider 必须定义 key 和 label
realtime.provider_needs_key_and_label.ko: Realtime Provider는 key와 label을 정의해야 합니다

realtime.provider_response_timeout_inval.en: Realtime Provider {key} responseStartTimeoutMs must be a positive number
realtime.provider_response_timeout_inval.zh: Realtime Provider {key} 的 responseStartTimeoutMs 必须是正数

realtime.provider_create_protocol_not_fu.en: Realtime Provider {key} createProtocol must be a function
realtime.provider_create_protocol_not_fu.zh: Realtime Provider {key} createProtocol 必须是函数

realtime.provider_connection_messages_no.en: Realtime Provider {key} protocol.connectionMessages must be a function
realtime.provider_connection_messages_no.zh: Realtime Provider {key} protocol.connectionMessages 必须是函数

realtime.provider_unknown_capability.en: Realtime Provider {key} declares an unknown capability: {flag}
realtime.provider_unknown_capability.zh: Realtime Provider {key} 声明了未知能力：{flag}
realtime.provider_unknown_capability.ko: Realtime Provider {key}가 알 수 없는 기능을 선언했습니다: {flag}

realtime.provider_capability_not_boolean.en: Realtime Provider {key} capability {flag} must be a boolean
realtime.provider_capability_not_boolean.zh: Realtime Provider {key} 的能力 {flag} 必须是布尔值

realtime.provider_model_profile_not_func.en: Realtime Provider {key} modelProfile must be a function
realtime.provider_model_profile_not_func.zh: Realtime Provider {key} modelProfile 必须是函数

realtime.provider_name_taken.en: Realtime Provider name is already registered: {name}
realtime.provider_name_taken.ko: Realtime Provider 이름이 이미 등록되어 있습니다: {name}

realtime.missing_configuration.en: the {label} frontend cannot be used; check its service address and configuration.
realtime.missing_configuration.zh: 无法使用 {label} 前台，请检查其服务地址和配置。
realtime.missing_configuration.ko: {label} 프런트엔드를 사용할 수 없습니다. 서비스 주소와 설정을 확인하세요.

realtime.connect_timeout_dashscope.en: timed out connecting to Qwen Audio Realtime
realtime.connect_timeout_dashscope.zh: 连接 Qwen Audio Realtime 超时
realtime.connect_timeout_dashscope.ko: Qwen Audio Realtime 연결 시간이 초과되었습니다

realtime.connect_timeout_speech_to_speec.en: timed out connecting to the Hugging Face speech-to-speech service ({url}); confirm the speech-to-speech service is running
realtime.connect_timeout_speech_to_speec.zh: 连接 Hugging Face speech-to-speech 服务超时（{url}），请确认 speech-to-speech 服务已启动
realtime.connect_timeout_speech_to_speec.ko: Hugging Face speech-to-speech 서비스 연결 시간이 초과되었습니다({url}). speech-to-speech 서비스가 실행 중인지 확인하세요

realtime.item_create_failed.en: {label} failed to create the conversation item

realtime.response_correlation_conflict.en: Realtime response correlation conflict: a response is already waiting for response.created
realtime.response_correlation_conflict.zh: Realtime 响应关联冲突：已有响应正在等待 response.created
realtime.response_correlation_conflict.ko: Realtime 응답 연결 충돌: 이미 response.created를 기다리는 응답이 있습니다

realtime.model_never_replied.en: the realtime model never started replying; the voice connection recovered automatically, please say that again.
realtime.model_never_replied.zh: 实时模型没有开始回复，语音连接已自动恢复，请再说一次。
realtime.model_never_replied.ko: 실시간 모델이 응답을 시작하지 않아 음성 연결을 자동으로 복구했습니다. 다시 말씀해 주세요.

realtime.reconnect_failed.zh: 实时语音连接恢复失败：{detail}

realtime.permission_ask_failed.en: cannot ask for permission right now: {detail}

realtime.permission_answer_failed.en: cannot process the permission answer right now: {detail}
realtime.permission_answer_failed.zh: 暂时无法处理权限回答：{detail}
realtime.permission_answer_failed.ko: 지금은 권한 응답을 처리할 수 없습니다: {detail}

realtime.announcement_retrying.en: the backend result cannot be announced right now; retrying automatically: {detail}
realtime.announcement_retrying.zh: 后台结果暂时无法播报，正在自动重试：{detail}
realtime.announcement_retrying.ko: 지금은 백엔드 결과를 안내할 수 없어 자동으로 재시도합니다: {detail}

realtime.project_start_announcement_fail.en: cannot announce the project start right now: {detail}
realtime.project_start_announcement_fail.zh: 暂时无法播报项目启动说明：{detail}
realtime.project_start_announcement_fail.ko: 지금은 프로젝트 시작 안내를 전달할 수 없습니다: {detail}

realtime.attachment_context_failed.en: the attachment context did not reach the voice frontend: {detail}
realtime.attachment_context_failed.zh: 附件上下文没有成功送达语音前台：{detail}
realtime.attachment_context_failed.ko: 첨부 컨텍스트가 음성 프런트엔드에 전달되지 않았습니다: {detail}

realtime.wake_word_model_incomplete.en: the wake-word model is missing required files
realtime.wake_word_model_incomplete.zh: 唤醒词模型缺少必需文件

realtime.restored_context_instructions.en: This is the recent conversation from before the connection was established. It is context only, not a new user request.
realtime.restored_context_instructions.zh: 这是连接建立前的近期对话，只用于衔接上下文，不是用户的新请求。
realtime.restored_context_instructions.ko: 연결이 수립되기 전의 최근 대화입니다. 맥락 연결용일 뿐 사용자의 새 요청이 아닙니다.

realtime.progress_instructions.en:
This is a progress update for a background task. It is not a final result and not a new user request.
Say the progress briefly in one natural sentence, and do not call a tool.
realtime.progress_instructions.zh:
这是后台任务的进度更新，不是最终结果，也不是用户的新请求。
用一句自然的话简短说明进度，不要调用工具。
realtime.progress_instructions.ko:
백그라운드 작업의 진행 상황 업데이트입니다. 최종 결과도, 사용자의 새 요청도 아닙니다.
자연스러운 한 문장으로 진행 상황을 짧게 전하고 도구는 호출하지 마세요.

realtime.permission_resolved_note.en: (System note: the backend permission request from a moment ago has been handled and the task is continuing; there is no need to ask about it or respond to it again.)
realtime.permission_resolved_note.zh: （系统提示：刚才的后台权限请求已处理完毕，任务继续执行；无需再询问或回应该请求。）
realtime.permission_resolved_note.ko: (시스템 안내: 조금 전의 백엔드 권한 요청은 처리되었고 작업이 계속됩니다. 다시 묻거나 응답할 필요가 없습니다.)

realtime.work_results_header.en: Below are the final results of previously submitted work. They are not a new user request.
realtime.work_results_header.zh: 以下是先前提交工作的最终结果，不是用户的新请求。
realtime.work_results_header.ko: 아래는 이전에 제출한 작업의 최종 결과입니다. 사용자의 새 요청이 아닙니다.

realtime.result_truncated_suffix.en: … (the event content was too long and was truncated; the full result is still kept in the task record)
realtime.result_truncated_suffix.zh: …（事件内容过长，已截断；完整结果仍保留在任务记录中）
realtime.result_truncated_suffix.ko: …(이벤트 내용이 너무 길어 잘렸습니다. 전체 결과는 작업 기록에 그대로 남아 있습니다)
